_about: Wire-format conformance corpus (TEST-23): every case goes through every consumer (Rust derive, ww_self dynamic, Python, C), see docs/serdes/conformance.md.
type: a property of conformance_api's Conformance trait (or a Rust type outside the API model); value: in the wire_weaver_py form; bytes: the golden bytes in hex.
direction: both (default), decode (bytes decode to value, value encodes otherwise), reject (bytes don't decode), reject_value (value doesn't encode).
A float JSON can't hold is written as the string "NaN", "inf" or "-inf" where the type is a float (NUM-19).
gaps: consumer -> why it can't run the case yet, with the FEATURES.md id that fixes it. A missing or stale mark fails the tests.
wire_change: "EVO-n / reason", the escape the frozen golden bytes guard (TEST-24) accepts for a deliberate change to bytes, direction or bytes_from, with a matching EVO item and CHANGELOG entry.
New case: add it here with "bytes": "?" and to tests/conformance/src/derive.rs, then just conformance-update and review the bytes.

withdrawn: cases removed with the wire feature they covered before it reached a release, by name with "ID / reason"; the frozen golden bytes guard (TEST-24) lets a sealed case go only this way, and the name stays taken.
decoded, encodes_to: for a case of a codec's Coded type (LVL-6), the linear number its code means and, when not its own code, the code that number encodes back to (nearest-even); sealed like bytes.

requantize: a stored number converted to another scale and storage (STD-63): factor is the quotient of the scales (a magnitude value), rounding truncate|floor|ceil|nearest_even|nearest_away, overflow checked|saturate|wrap, result the stored number after it (null: no value). conversion names the typed conversion in tests/conformance/src/requantize.rs.
